description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain class implementations, including reentrant and non-reentrant grains, with methods for interleaving, stream subscription, and self-managed grains, primarily used for testing concurrency and interleaving behaviors.

classes.name: ReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain with methods for calling itself and setting self-reference.

classes.name: NonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant Orleans grain with logging in its lifecycle and methods.

classes.name: MayInterleaveStaticPredicateGrain
classes.description: A grain with static predicate for interleaving based on message arguments, and stream subscription capabilities.

classes.name: MayInterleaveInstancedPredicateGrain
classes.description: A grain with instance predicate for interleaving, similar to static predicate, with stream capabilities.

classes.name: UnorderedNonRentrantGrain
classes.description: A grain that supports unordered, non-reentrant calls.

classes.name: ReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: A self-managed reentrant grain with destination setting and ping method.

classes.name: NonReentrantSelfManagedGrain1
classes.description: A self-managed non-reentrant grain with similar capabilities as the reentrant version.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: A grain that performs fan-out calls to other grains, supporting reentrant and non-reentrant variants, with chain and batch methods.

classes.name: FanOutACGrain
classes.description: A variant of FanOutGrain with additional methods for chain calls and stream interactions.

classes.name: ReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain with methods for setting destinations, pinging with delay, and getting counters.

classes.name: NonReentrantTaskGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant counterpart to ReentrantTaskGrain, with similar methods.

classes.name: CallOrderingGrain
classes.description: A grain demonstrating method call ordering and interleaving control with a log and unblock mechanism.

methods.name: Two
methods.description: Calls Self.One() and appends ' two' to the result.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method for activation, with logging.

methods.name: MethodA
methods.description: Method that logs entry and exit, with blocking for interleaving control.

methods.name: MethodB
methods.description: Another method with similar interleaving control.

methods.name: Unblock
methods.description: Method to unblock MethodA and MethodB.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the log and interleaving blocker.

methods.name: GetLog
methods.description: Returns the current log of method calls.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simulates a delay and then retrieves a counter from another grain.

methods.name: SetDestination
methods.description: Sets the destination grain ID for ping-pong style calls.
